subcommands.name: create-dataset
subcommands.description: Creates a new dataset in an Amazon Lookout for Vision project.

options.name: --project-name
options.description: The name of the project in which you want to create a dataset

options.name: --dataset-type
options.description: The type of the dataset.

options.name: --dataset-source
options.description: The location of the manifest file that Amazon Lookout for Vision uses to create the dataset.

options.name: --client-token
options.description: ClientToken is an idempotency token that ensures a call to CreateDataset completes only once.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: list-dataset-entries
subcommands.description: Lists the JSON Lines within a dataset.

options.name: --project-name
options.description: The name of the project that contains the dataset that you want to list

options.name: --dataset-type
options.description: The type of the dataset that you want to list.

options.name: --labeled
options.description: Specify true to include labeled entries, otherwise specify false.

options.name: --no-labeled
options.description: Specify true to include labeled entries, otherwise specify false.

options.name: --anomaly-class
options.description: Specify normal to include only normal images.

options.name: --before-creation-date
options.description: Only includes entries before the specified date in the response.

options.name: --after-creation-date
options.description: Only includes entries after the specified date in the response.

options.name: --next-token
options.description: If the previous response was incomplete (because there is more data to retrieve), Amazon Lookout for Vision returns a pagination token in the response.

options.name: --max-results
options.description: The maximum number of results to return per paginated call.

options.name: --source-ref-contains
options.description: Perform a "contains" search on the values of the source-ref key within the dataset.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --starting-token
options.description: A token to specify where to start paginating.

options.name: --page-size
options.description: The size of each page to get in the AWS service call.

options.name: --max-items
options.description: The total number of items to return in the command's output.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
